description: shipwright hooks for Codex. Same three scripts as .claude/settings.json, from .agents/hooks/. Codex supports SessionStart, Stop and PreToolUse, so no event is dropped. Two limits: (1) Codex has no CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR, so each command sets it from the git root; (2) guard_edits.py reads tool_input.file_path, which Codex's apply_patch tool does not send, so the edit guard is inert on Codex until the hook learns the apply_patch input shape. Project hooks run only after you trust them with /hooks.
